Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5316; non-manifested, i.e. invisible:--vanished out of sight.
BiblicalUsage: Vanished out of their sight — Jesus, known in the breaking of bread at Emmaus, vanishing from the two disciples' eyes. One verse, and the whole resurrection morning in it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe he vanished so they would carry the news rather than keep the sight, and that is still how it works.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
